settings.heading: The pattern you keep seeing
settings.text: Congestion that returns. Marks that linger. A routine that never quite settles. Most people do not need more products — they need a clearer read of what is actually happening.
settings.detail: We start with context: climate, barrier history, actives you have already tried, and what “better” would mean for you.

settings.heading: A conversation that goes past the shelf
settings.text: Thirty minutes with a dermatologist — secure video — focused on your history, not a product pitch. Bring what you use. Bring what failed. Bring the climate you live in.
settings.detail: The goal is mechanism and practicality: what to keep, what to pause, and what to change first.

settings.heading: Leave with a plan you can follow
settings.text: You receive a written routine summary — sequence, cadence, and what to watch for. Not a shopping list of twelve serums. A path you can still keep in week four.
settings.detail: Follow-up guidance is included so the next decision is clearer than the last.

settings.heading: Your skin has a story. Tell it to someone who can read it.
settings.text: Not another product quiz. A real conversation — concerns, climate, what you already tried — ending in a written plan.
settings.cta_heading: Ready for a clearer next step?
settings.cta_text: Thirty minutes. Secure video. A routine summary you can actually follow.
